proposed.text: What was the key difference between HUDCC and HLURB in terms of their roles in Philippine housing governance?

options.text: HUDCC regulated developers; HLURB coordinated agencies, focusing on policy implementation and oversight
HUDCC built housing; HLURB financed housing, with each agency having distinct operational mandates
HUDCC and HLURB performed identical functions under different names, which often led to confusion in their roles
HUDCC coordinated inter-agency programs; HLURB regulated private developers

proposed.rationale: HUDCC was a coordinating council bringing agencies together. HLURB was the regulatory board overseeing developer compliance with PD 957. They had entirely different functions. [A]: This reverses their roles. [B]: Neither built or financed housing as their primary roles. [C]: They had distinct, complementary functions.
